page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 6 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

The underlying Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 (AVX512F and AVX512_VNNI) for vector processing and deep learning acceleration, alongside cryptographic extensions like AES and SHA_NI. In performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates mid-range capabilities, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 1593.0 and a multi-core score of 7907.0. Software compilation via Clang scored 11951.0, while stress-ng multi-core CPU performance reached 11625.39, reflecting stable compute capacity for multi-threaded tasks.

Memory subsystem benchmarks show a read-only cached small block bandwidth of 629.96 GB/sec, which drops to 81.59 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 53.67 GB/sec. The instance handles database operations effectively, recording 5907.31 operations in Passmark tests and processing 11.74 million Redis SET operations per second. For web serving, it achieves a static throughput of 16.97 GB/sec. While it handles small LLM inference tasks efficiently, performance drops significantly on larger models, with a 7B model managing only 23.62 tokens/sec during prompt processing.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.3xlarge provides a balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The lack of local NVMe storage represents a tradeoff, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. This instance is well-suited for application servers, containerized microservices, software development builds, web serving, and moderate database workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 12 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of RAM, running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.7 GHz. Utilizing the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. It delivers steady mid-range performance, as evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 7907.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 16288.42. The processor supports AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerations, enabling efficient text processing, software compilation, and database operations, with Redis SET operations reaching 11.74 million per second. With an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, this instance offers a cost-effective, balanced profile for general-purpose workloads such as web serving, application hosting, and microservices, though it exhibits limited efficiency for larger machine learning models.
